title: Queued Asynchronous Scene Transition
description: Create a scene transition coordinator with loading progress, fade stages, cancellation rules, and duplicate-request handling.
requirements: Only one transition may actively load at a time.
Duplicate requests must have defined behaviour.
Loading progress must be exposed independently from UI.
A failed load must restore a valid state.
Scene activation must occur only after required transition stages complete.
constraint: Design the public API first and include a short usage example.
stretchGoal: Support runtime configuration changes without rebuilding the entire system.
